measuredAgainst.source: PyPI, installed into a clean virtual environment
measuredAgainst.note: the published artifact, not a source checkout

comparedTo.note: EXP-005 measured a source checkout of the pre-port `aegl` module with 10 engines. This measures published aegoll 0.1.1. The median p50 moved 299 -> 168 us, but see the spread: this experiment's own p50 ranges 139-330 us across ten runs, which overlaps EXP-005's single reported figure. The honest reading is that the two are not cleanly comparable, not that the layer got 1.8x faster.

limitations.environment: one Windows 11 laptop, shared with other work during measurement
limitations.spread: p50 varies 2.4x across ten identical runs. That variance is the finding: any single-run figure for this measurement, including EXP-003's 128 us and EXP-005's 299 us, carries no error bar and should not be quoted as precise.
limitations.notMeasured: no model was invoked and nothing settled; this is the decision path alone
